caribbean.headline: Bimini Faces Moderate Winds, High Rain Probability
caribbean.paragraph: Bimini is experiencing 22 kt winds and 2.7 ft waves with 75% rain probability. Freeport remains under 15 kt winds and modest wave activity.

mediterranean.headline: Haifa Faces Moderate Winds, 5.8ft Waves, 38% Rain
mediterranean.paragraph: Haifa is experiencing sustained winds up to 13 kt, waves up to 5.8 ft, a dominant WNW swell period of 6 s, and a 38% rain probability. Marseille sees sustained winds up to 15 kt, with modest wave conditions.
